notes: Removed fictional detectives and spies still under copyright or trademarked (Sam Spade removed although The Maltese Falcon entered US public domain in 2026, UK copyright runs to 2031); kept Sherlock Holmes, Watson, Moriarty, Baker Street, Auguste Dupin and Father Brown (public domain), and real spies/authors (Ian Fleming, John le Carré, Mata Hari). Added Quran and Torah to holy books (they were only in islam words/judaism words; the level builder should keep those themes apart). Kept 'grand theft auto' in crimes as the legal term. 'St Davids' (pilgrimage) left without apostrophe: that is the city's official name. 'St.' forms written American with the British 'St' form in uk. Swapped Number Ten -> Number 10, ten-four -> 10-4, fifty/twenty/ten pence -> 50p/20p/10p, CAC -> CAC 40. Capitalised Congress, Senate, House, Supreme Court, Constitution, Electoral College (us government), Chancellor (british politics), Zen, Mass. Left plain where dictionaries do: zloty, guarani, tugrik, Soto, Cao Dai, reichsmark. angels and spirits not marked separate though it mixes folklore spirits (banshee, poltergeist, wendigo) with religious angels/demons; mark it separate if those read wrong in a religion level. Parent 'government' is not in this batch; only international organizations under it marked separate (FIFA, Greenpeace, Oxfam don't read as government).
